text:
Keiko: Quick flag Support keeps getting bug reports where apps show a raw `APIError` and users are confused. We need a tiny, deterministic surface so client code can pick an action (retry / reauth / show hint / contact support).

Sam: Agreed. My proposal: a compact envelope with `kind` (auth|rate_limit|validation|safety|transient), `action` (retry|reauth|fix_input|contact_support), `user_visible` (bool), `retry_after` (secs opt), `copy_key` (for localized UX), and `support_ref` (opaque id for logs). Keep `message` short and never put stack traces in it.

Marta: +1 to `copy_key` and `user_visible`. Principle: if `user_visible=false` frontends must render a generic apology message and log `support_ref` to the console/support panel. Don't let SDKs accidentally leak internals.

Ibrahim: Parity notes: python can keep subclasses but ensure `.kind` and `.action` attrs exist; JS should set `err.kind`, `err.action`, `err.user_visible` so callers don't have to parse strings; Go: expose typed errors implementing Kind()/Action()/RetryAfter(). Add unit tests that assert these properties.

Keiko: Sampleapp idea: include a tiny table mapping `kind`->UI flow and small components showing each flow. E.g. auth->button "Reconnect"; rate_limit->countdown using `retry_after`; validation->focus field + show copy from `copy_key`; safety->neutral message + contact flow. Keep copy in a shared JSON map keyed by `copy_key`.

Sam: Example envelope (illustrative):

```
{
  "error": {
    "kind": "rate_limit",
    "action": "retry",
    "user_visible": true,
    "retry_after": 12,
    "copy_key": "errors.rate_limit.wait_short",
    "support_ref": "sup-250-88",
    "message": "Too many requests"
  }
}
```

Marta: Two operational rules: 1) server must not vary the envelope fields between releases without an RFC; 2) SDKs must not implement brittle parsing logic based on `message`. Use `kind` and `action`.

Ibrahim: I'll draft a tiny RFC with the canonical envelope and begin a JS PR that surfaces `err.kind` and `err.action`. Also will add parity tests in CI.

devex-bot: Created ticket DEVEX-1400: "SDK: compact error envelope + sampleapp mapping + parity tests" and linked this thread.

Keiko: Thanks team. Can we sync 20m tomorrow to lock `copy_key` names and which SDKs get first PRs? @Ibrahim @Sam please add RFC/PR links to DEVEX-1400 before the sync. :thumbsup:
